title: FFT Hero #1 Phase14 — Noncommuting Toeplitz Full-Rank Gate
exact_full_rank_algorithm_cost: O(N*M + N*log(G/M) + N*log(m+1)) for q=M; with M~=logG, O(NlogG+Nlogm), not faster than Cooley-Tukey asymptotically
restricted_O_N_result: Exact normalized Fourier on q=O(1) preselected chirp unions with fixed odd m, including generally dense structured inputs, exact complex arithmetic
deterministic_error: ||F_N x - F_N Pi x||_2^2 = ||x||_2^2 - sum b* Gamma^-1 b
stationary_toeplitz_identity: V_{s,r}=D_{s,r} W; W[u,i]=zeta^(-i*(K*C(u,2)+(K+1)*u)); Gram=W*W independent of block and Toeplitz; q=M invertible since exponent modulo K equals u
fixed_q_local_rank_obstruction: for some impulse, relative squared residual >=1-q/M
same_clock_graph_orbit_limit: K*(2*M*M+1)/3 unique (clock,destination) pairs of M*G visited when G=K*M and M power-of-two; asymptotic ratio 2/3, NOT general circuit lower bound
precision_warning: float64 is NOT a rigorous interval/bit-complexity certificate; root table error O(G*u) can accumulate and subtracting captured energy near full norm suffers cancellation
proof_scope: Exact algebraic identities + finite-field all-basis verification; not a novel unconditional complexity bound or formalized theorem
